text_to_speech: MCCLOSKEY: “A tiny bit simple-minded, I have to say.” POWELL: “How did you change your mind?” MCCLOSKEY: “Well, very slowly. I was at Harvard College. Bernie Sanders and Jeremy Corbyn and I, in say 1960—we’re about the same age—we all had the same opinion: capitalism is the problem, let’s have a revolution. The problem is that those two guys haven’t changed their opinion. I’ve changed my opinion on lots of things, including my gender.”

youtube_description:
In this episode of Free Thoughts, Deirdre McCloskey’s talks about her personal ideological journey from “Joan Baez-style” Marxism to classical liberalism.
